fields.summary_ko.0: MRVL fell 35.9% over the past month, steeper than the industry average 22% and technology sector 14.1% decline, reflecting broad-based selling in AI-related stocks.
fields.summary_ko.1: MRVL Q2 fiscal 2027 revenue of $2.74 billion grew 37% year-over-year (data center revenue of $2.17 billion, +46%), with fiscal 2027 revenue growth revised upward to 45% at approximately $12 billion.
fields.summary_ko.2: Lumentum acquisition announcement at $11.5 billion weighs on share price, with long-term expectations for expanded optical and photonics technology portfolio for AI data centers.
